display.purpose: Page titles (with the 4px ink rule), section/collapsible/modal headings. Always 800 weight, uppercase, 0.02em tracking.

body.purpose: All prose and form values. Never uppercase, never bold beyond ~600.

label.purpose: Button text and badges — uppercase, 700 weight, tracked. Names an action or category, never a sentence.

shadows.name: poster-pop
shadows.purpose: The one shadow in the system. Hard offset, no blur — for the page sheet, modals, dropdown menus, and toasts only. Never on resting cards, buttons, or inputs.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Default easing for buttons/inputs/nav hover and focus state changes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default call-to-action. Vermilion fill, white uppercase label, zero radius.
components.css: .ds-btn { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; border: none; border-radius: 0; padding: 8px 15px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary { background: #C8401F; color: #fff; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #A83415; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1C1A16; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: color-mix(in srgb, #C8401F 38%, #F2EFE4); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Poster inversion: ink outline that fills solid on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #1C1A16; border: 1.5px solid #1C1A16; padding: 7px 14px; border-radius: 0; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #1C1A16; color: #F2EFE4; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C8401F; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive actions — a distinct deep-red hue so it never reads as a primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: #8F2410; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 0; padding: 8px 15px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #8F2410 85%, black); }

components.name: Filled Badge
components.description: Small squared status/category chip, filled, uppercase, tracked.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 2px; background: #C8401F; color: #F2EFE4; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Card
components.description: The base container: cream-white fill, ink hairline border, zero radius, no shadow.
components.html:
Section title

Card body text sits here at 14px.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FBFAF3; border: 1px solid #1C1A16; border-radius: 0; padding: 20px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.02em; font-size: 17px; color: #141311; margin-bottom: 16px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Ink-bordered field; focus swaps the border to vermilion, no glow ring.
components.css: .ds-input { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; border: 1px solid #1C1A16; border-radius: 0; padding: 7px 10px; width: 100%; background: #FBFAF3; color: #1C1A16; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #C8401F; }

components.name: Active Nav Item
components.description: The active sidebar link reads as a cream tab cut from the poster sheet against the teal wall.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 9px 20px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; border-left: 3px solid transparent; color: color-mix(in srgb, #F2EFE4 82%, transparent); transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-nav-item-active { color: #1C1A16; border-left-color: #C8401F; background: #F2EFE4; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Squared single-choice control; the ink-fill selected state mirrors the secondary-button hover treatment app-wide.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid #1C1A16; width: fit-content; } .ds-seg-btn { padding: 6px 14px; background: transparent; border: none; border-right: 1px solid #1C1A16; font-size: 13px; color: #1C1A16; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg-btn:last-child { border-right: none; } .ds-seg-active { background: #1C1A16; color: #F2EFE4; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview: Job Coach reads as something printed, not something rendered: ink-black hairline rules, flat color blocks instead of gradients, hard offset shadows instead of soft blurs, and squared corners everywhere. Each page is a cream poster sheet laid on a muted teal gallery wall (the app shell behind the fixed sidebar) — the sheet gets a hard drop shadow, the wall doesn't. Headings are one grotesque family (Inter), always bold and uppercase; there is no second display font pretending to be more decorative than the first. That printed confidence is structural, not emotional. Job Coach's brand personality is calm, trustworthy, reassuring — job hunting is stressful enough — so the boldness lives in geometry and typography, while color usage, motion, and copy stay restrained. Vermilion is loud by hue, but it is rationed to one thing at a time.
keyCharacteristics: Flat ink-on-cream print system: zero border-radius, hairline borders, no gradients
One grotesque type family; hierarchy is weight/case/size, not font-switching
A single accent (vermilion) used sparingly, rationed to primary actions and state
A teal counterpoint used specifically for AI/"good" signals (success, AI badges)
Hard offset shadows reserved for things that float: modals, menus, toasts, the page sheet itself

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Every border, hairline, and rule in the system is --ink (#1C1A16) at full or mixed opacity — never a separate mid-gray border color.

rules.name: The Rationed Accent Rule
rules.body: Vermilion marks one primary thing per view: the default action, the active tab, or the single most important chip. If two elements both want vermilion, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Case Signal Rule
rules.body: Uppercase means "this labels an action or category." Sentence case means "this is content." Never uppercase a sentence the user is meant to read as prose.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Nothing in normal document flow gets a shadow. Shadows are reserved for elements that visually detach from the page (overlays, floating menus, the page sheet against the wall).

dos: Do keep every border and rule at --ink; never introduce a separate gray border token.
Do ration vermilion to one primary signal per screen.
Do keep hard, offset, blur-free shadows exclusive to floating elements.
Do keep uppercase reserved for actions/labels/headings and sentence case for content.
Do keep copy and motion calm even where the geometry is bold.
donts: Don't round any corner — border-radius is 0px everywhere except the 2px chip radius.
Don't build a generic SaaS dashboard: no soft card shadows, no blue-and-white gradients, no pastel status pills.
Don't read as corporate job-board chrome: avoid dense blue UI chrome or stock-photo emptiness.
Don't give the AI a chat-bot persona: no chat bubbles, no glowing gradient orbs, no sparkle/magic-wand iconography.
Don't use a second display typeface for decorative contrast — Inter carries the whole hierarchy alone.
Don't soften the vermilion into a lighter tint for primary actions — softness lives in copy and motion, not in desaturating the accent.
